description: Vertebrate ortholog conservation of the E2-binding face and linchpin in LONRF1/2/3 RINGs
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

def fetch_orth(gene):
    url=(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:{gene}+AND+taxonomy_id:7742+AND+length:[600 TO 900]'
         '&format=json&fields=accession,organism_name,length,sequence&size=500')
    r=requests.get(url,timeout=180).json()
    rec={}
    for e in r['results']:
        org=e['organism']['scientificName']; s=e['sequence']['value']
        if org not in rec or len(s)>len(rec[org][1]): rec[org]=(e['primaryAccession'],s)
    return rec
def ligs(s):
    return [[m.start(i)+1 for i in range(1,9)] for m in
            re.finditer(r'(?=(C).{2}(C).{9,39}(C).{1,3}([HC]).{2,3}([HC]).{2}(C).{4,48}(C).{2}(C))', s)]
FRAME=[('L1+1',0,1),('L2-1',1,-1),('L2+1',1,1),('L2+2',1,2),('L6+3',5,3),('L6+4',5,4),
       ('L7+1',6,1),('L8-1',7,-1),('L8+1',7,1)]
HYD=set('AVLIMFWCY')
rows=[]
for gene in ['LONRF3','LONRF1','LONRF2']:
    rec=fetch_orth(gene)
    for org,(acc,s) in rec.items():
        Ls=ligs(s)
        if not Ls: continue
        pairs=[('RING1',Ls[0]),('RING2',Ls[-1])] if len(Ls)>=2 else [('RING2',Ls[0])]
        for tag,L in pairs:
            d=dict(gene=gene,organism=org,acc=acc,ring=tag)
            for lab,i,off in FRAME:
                p=L[i]+off; d[lab]=s[p-1] if 1<=p<=len(s) else '-'
            rows.append(d)
O=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print('unique species per gene/ring:'); print(O.groupby(['gene','ring']).size())

summ=[]
for (g,r),sub in O.groupby(['gene','ring']):
    n=len(sub)
    summ.append(dict(gene=g,ring=r,n=n,
        linchpin_RK=round(100*sub['L8+1'].isin(list('RK')).mean(),1),
        L7p1_Pro=round(100*(sub['L7+1']=='P').mean(),1),
        L8m1_hydrophobic=round(100*sub['L8-1'].isin(HYD).mean(),1),
        L2m1_hydrophobic=round(100*sub['L2-1'].isin(HYD).mean(),1),
        L2p1_hydrophobic=round(100*sub['L2+1'].isin(HYD).mean(),1),
        modal_L8p1=Counter(sub['L8+1']).most_common(2),
        modal_L7p1=Counter(sub['L7+1']).most_common(2)))
Sm=pd.DataFrame(summ)
pd.set_option('display.width',260)
print('\n% of vertebrate orthologs with the canonical residue class at each E2-face / linchpin position:')
print(Sm.to_string(index=False))
O.to_csv('lonrf_ortholog_frame_all.csv',index=False); Sm.to_csv('lonrf_ortholog_summary.csv',index=False)

# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
cols=['L2m1_hydrophobic','L2p1_hydrophobic','L8m1_hydrophobic','L7p1_Pro','linchpin_RK']
labs=['L2-1\nhydrophobic','L2+1\nhydrophobic','L8-1\nhydrophobic','L7+1\nPro','L8+1\nlinchpin R/K']
x=np.arange(len(cols)); w=0.16
keys=[('LONRF3','RING2'),('LONRF1','RING2'),('LONRF2','RING2'),('LONRF3','RING1'),('LONRF1','RING1')]
colors=['#1f77b4','#4c9fd6','#90c4e8','#d62728','#f08c8c']
for i,(g,r) in enumerate(keys):
    row=Sm[(Sm.gene==g)&(Sm.ring==r)]
    if not len(row): continue
    ax.bar(x+(i-2)*w,[row[c].values[0] for c in cols],w,label=f'{g} {r} (n={int(row.n.values[0])})',color=colors[i])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs); ax.set_ylabel('% of vertebrate orthologs')
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.axhline(100,ls=':',c='grey',lw=0.8)
ax.set_title('Conservation of RING E2-binding face and linchpin positions across vertebrate LONRF orthologs')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
